scenes.description: Monte Carlo [vue générale] · Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica).
scenes.explanation: Practical, mass-produced outboard motors for small boats did not exist in 1912, as the first commercially successful models appeared later.

scenes.title: Notre-Dame [de Paris]
scenes.description: Notre-Dame [de Paris] · Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica).
scenes.explanation: In 1912 street lamps along the Seine were gas or early electric and no lamp post had a solar panel or LED fixture, both of which are products of the late 20th and 21st centuries.

scenes.title: Simon [portrait du boxeur]
scenes.description: Simon [portrait du boxeur] · Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica).
scenes.anomaly: Modern boxing glove with Velcro wrist strap
scenes.explanation: Velcro was not invented until the 1940s and did not appear on boxing gloves until decades later, so it cannot exist in a 1914 photograph.
